name: fpr_default_off
description: Default-off contract: with EnableFpr unset the traditional balloon behavior is kept - no hold runs

test_steps.desc: Remove EnableFpr to restore the default (feature off)
test_steps.guest_run: Remove-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\BALLOON\Parameters' -Name EnableFpr -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Output 'PASS: EnableFpr removed'

test_steps.desc: Restart balloon device to re-negotiate features
Give a stray hold time to become visible
Verify no hold is running (available stays high)
